user.title: Connect Eufy Viewer bridge
user.description: Enter the address and access token of your dedicated Eufy Viewer bridge. The bridge must already be running. No cameras will be started.

account.title: Sign in to Eufy
account.description: Use a dedicated Eufy account with shared access to your cameras. Credentials are stored on your local bridge, not in this Home Assistant entry.

verify.title: Verification code
verify.description: Enter the verification code sent by Eufy.

captcha.title: Complete the captcha
captcha.description:
![Captcha]({captcha_image})

Enter the characters shown in the image.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot communicate with the bridge. Check its address and connection.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Check the credentials or verification code.

abort.wrong_bridge: This endpoint belongs to a different bridge. Add it as a separate integration.
abort.invalid_bridge_auth: The bridge rejected its access token. Start setup again with the correct token.
